fields.System.Title: EPIC RET — Returns
fields.System.Description:
Goal

Goods coming back from customers are received, inspected, and routed to the right destination —
without damaged stock ever reaching a sellable location.

Business value

Returns are a cost centre that becomes a much larger cost centre when handled badly. The
expensive failure is not slow processing; it is restocking something that should not have been
restocked, shipping it again, and paying for a second return.

Return data is also a quality signal. A product with a return rate far above its peers usually
has a master data problem upstream — wrong description, wrong image, wrong size guide.

Scope

In. Return authorisations. Receiving returns against an RMA and blind. Quarantine landing.
Inspection with recorded outcome and evidence. Disposition: restock as new, restock as graded,
repair, return to supplier, scrap. ERP credit notification. Return rate reporting.

Out. Refund calculation and payment. Customer communication. Repair work itself.

Done when

  • An RMA can be raised against a shipped order, with quantity validated against what shipped.
  • A return can be received with an RMA, or blind with approval.
  • Returned stock always lands in quarantine — there is no path that skips it.
  • Nothing becomes sellable without a recorded inspection outcome.
  • Restocked stock carries a fresh receipt date and re-captured expiry.
  • Scrapping requires approval and a reason code.

Key risks

| Risk | Why it matters | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Returned stock goes straight to available | Damaged goods reship; the cycle repeats | [doc 09 §8.1](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Inspection is a rubber stamp | Same outcome, with an audit trail that says it was checked | [doc 09 §8.2](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Restocked with the original expiry | FEFO treats old stock as fresh | [doc 09 §8.3](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Return processed twice | Stock created from nothing; customer credited twice | [doc 09 §8.4](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Original order not found | Cannot validate quantity | [doc 05 WF 9](../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Quarantine stock never dispositioned | Space consumed, stock invisible | [doc 05 WF 9](../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
